WoodPlatformTiles.name: Draw wood platform; signed division helper
summary: $02D848: draws a 4-tile wooden platform (shared by sprites that look like one) at the sprite's screen position, palette 1.
$02D870: signed division helper. Parameters: A = signed value, X = sprite index. Returns: A = high byte of (|A| * 256 / ([$187B,X] / 2)) * 16 with the sign of A; [$0E] = low byte.

BubbleSpriteMain.name: Bubble sprite: main wrapper
summary: Sprite $9D. Sets the data bank and calls the bubble code.

BubbleSprGfxProp2.name: Table: bubble X speed by direction

BubbleSprGfxProp4.name: Bubble sprite: logic and contents release
summary: Sprite $9D: a floating bubble containing Goomba, Bob-omb, sprite $15 or a Mushroom ([RAM_SpriteState] = 0-3).
Draws the contents plus the bubble, drifts sideways with a bobbing Y speed, pops on touching Mario or a wall, then turns into the contained sprite.
[$1534] is the bubble's pop timer: the contents spawn when it reaches 1.

BubbleSize.name: Draw bubble graphics
summary: Draws the 5 bubble tiles (4 corners and a center) with a 3-phase wobble animation, or the burst tiles $64/$66 when [$1534] < 6.
Tables BubbleSize ($02D9CD) and DATA_02D9D2 (animation offsets $00,$05,$0A,$05) precede the code at $02D9D6.

HammerBrotherMain.name: Hammer Bro: main wrapper
summary: Sprite $9B. Sets the data bank and calls the Hammer Bro code.

HammerFreq.name: Hammer Bro behaviour and hammer throw
summary: Turns around periodically, and throws a hammer when [$1570] & HammerFreq is 0 (more often on submaps other than the main map).
Hammers are extended sprite $04, thrown upward at Y speed $D0 and X speed +/-$10.

GenerateHammer.name: Generate hammer extended sprite
summary: Parameters: Y = free extended sprite slot, [$00] = hammer X speed.

HammerBroDispX.name: Table: Hammer Bro tile X offsets

HammerBroDispY.name: Table: Hammer Bro tile Y offsets

HammerBroGfx.name: Draw Hammer Bro
summary: Draws 4 tiles; flipped horizontally per the direction flag, using a second tile set when facing left.

FlyingPlatformMain.name: Hammer Bro platform: main wrapper
summary: Sprite $9C. Sets the data bank and calls the platform code.

s02DB54.name: Table: platform acceleration and speed limits

s02DB5C.name: Hammer Bro platform: logic
summary: Draws the platform, finds a Hammer Bro (sprite $9B) in sprite slots 0-9 and carries it on the platform ($1594 = its slot, $FF if none).
Floats in a Lissajous-like path: X/Y speed accelerate toward +/-$20 and flip on reaching the limit.
Acts as a solid block (InvisBlkMainRt). When Mario lands on it ([$1558] non-zero) the Hammer Bro is probably knocked off.

PutHammerBroOnPlat.name: Place Hammer Bro on platform and move platform
summary: Puts the Hammer Bro 16 pixels above the platform and draws it, then runs the platform movement, solid-block and Mario-landing code (see previous section).

HmrBroPlatTiles.name: Table: platform tiles, properties, sizes and dip

FlyingPlatformGfx.name: Draw Hammer Bro platform
summary: Draws 4 tiles with 2 animation sets; the tile on the side Mario stands on dips by DATA_02DC37[[$1558] / 2] pixels.

SumoBrotherMain.name: Sumo Bro: main wrapper and state dispatch
summary: Sprite $9A. Draws, then runs interaction/physics and dispatches [RAM_SpriteState]: 0 and 1 = short pauses that step the animation frame, 2 = walk, 3 = stomp.

s02DD0C.name: Table: Sumo Bro X speed by direction

s02DD0E.name: Sumo Bro walk and stomp states
summary: Walk state: moves at X speed +/-$20, pausing every other step; after 3 steps it starts the stomp state (timer $70).
Stomp state: at timer $2E shakes the ground ([$1887] = $30), plays sound $09 and spawns lightning; then turns around.

GenSumoLightning.name: Spawn Sumo Bro lightning
summary: Spawns sprite $2B at the Sumo Bro's X + 4, same Y.

SumoBrosDispX.name: Table: Sumo Bro tile X offsets

SumoBrosDispY.name: Table: Sumo Bro tile Y offsets

SumoBroGfx.name: Draw Sumo Bro
summary: Draws 4 tiles for animation frame [$1602]; mirrored X offsets are used when the flip flag is set.
